paragraphs.text: Jacques le Vert was a legendary human warrior who lived in ancient times on Dominaria , before the Brothers' War .

Jacques was the first to bear the Sword of the Meek . He abandoned his sword to return to the tree city of Pendelhaven , his homeland, and devoted all of his life to protecting its creatures. He fought a legendary battle against The Brute in front of the city.

Jacques's battle with the Brute was depicted on a mosaic at the College of Lat-Nam . His name continued to be used millennia after his death as an oath for soldiers going into battle. Although the lush greenery of Pendelhaven withered after the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , the elders still carry the ancestral mantle of Jacques and continue his mission: to protect the creatures of his homeland.
